result.ca_name_from_pdf: Open Access Technology International, Inc. (OATI webCARES CA)
result.audit_criteria: WebTrust Principles and Criteria for Certification Authorities – SSL Baseline with Network Security – v2.7

disclosed_matters.summary: OATI's CPS v5.1 and v6.0 specified a validation re-use timeframe of 39 months (~1,186 days) but WebTrust Baseline Requirements 4.6 requires 825 days; however, OATI was compliant with the 825-day timeframe in actual operations per BRAF Work Instructions v5.3.
